Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the vendor onboarding / procurement milestones we discussed (Ariba/Coupa setup, vendor forms, W-9, banking details). High-level recap and proposed milestones: 

- Redwood delivers: W-9, vendor banking stub, completed vendor profile template (by 2026-06-30)
- Acme completes: vendor registration in Ariba/Coupa (by 2026-07-15)
- Procurement: confirms tax classification and banking fields, sends portal invite to Redwood if required (by 2026-07-08)
- Target go-live / invoice eligibility: 2026-07-22

Dependencies: Acme’s procurement portal access (Ariba vs. Coupa), DocuSign execution of the vendor agreement (if required), and verification of banking details by your AP team. I attached the MAP spreadsheet (Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx) and our current W-9 (Redwood_W9_2026.pdf) for your procurement team to reference.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll upload the MAP to a shared Drive and add target owners.
2) Samantha / Tom: confirm whether you prefer Ariba or Coupa and who will submit the vendor request from your side (name + email).
3) Dev (cc’d) will provide the banking stub and any additional documents your team needs for vendor setup.

Happy to hop on a quick 15-min call with procurement to walk through the vendor fields if that helps.

Thanks,
Marissa
